scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hey, I know you.
You took this test
before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嘿，我認識你。
你以前參加過這個測試，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been
to Valhalla and been reborn.
Wow, that's so impressive!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
啊，看來你去過瓦爾哈拉並轉生了。
哇，真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Err...
You'd better learn all the Basic Skills first before you can become an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
那個...
在成為弓箭手之前，你最好先學會所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好的，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well then. I don't
need to say anything else.
I know you'll make a great Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
那麼。我沒什麼要補充的了。
我相信你會成為一名出色的弓箭手...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although there's no special
reward for you this time, I hope you understand. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
雖然這次沒有特別的獎勵，希望你能理解。保重。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Oh...?
Hey, what are
you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
哦...？
嘿，你在這裡做什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I can tell that you're not cut out to be an Archer. It sort of feels like you're meant to do
something else...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
看得出來，你並不適合當弓箭手。感覺你似乎更適合做點別的...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Nice to meet you. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
很高興見到你。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成為弓箭手。

scripts.text: I need the requirements, please.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我要求。

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Haha, you are kidding me...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
哈哈，你在開玩笑吧...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I feel sorry but only Novices can change their job.
You already have your own decent job, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
很抱歉，只有初心者才能轉職。
你已經有自己的職業了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You are... {0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你是... {0}，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, you're not at the right skill level.
Your job level must be at least ^4A4AFF10^000000 and your Basic Skill level should reach ^4A4AFFlevel 9
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嗯，你的技能等級還不夠。
你的職業等級必須至少是 ^4A4AFF10^000000，並且基本技能等級需要達到 ^4A4AFF9級

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Because an Archer needs extremely high concentration, so we do not accept those who have little patience.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
因為弓箭手需要極高的專注力，所以我們不接受缺乏耐心的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Your Basic Skill is now enough..
....Hm~~ so you are now ready to be an Archer. I will take the step right away.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你的基本技能已經足夠了...
....嗯~~ 看來你已經準備好成為弓箭手了。我這就為你辦理轉職手續。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Congratulations! You are now an Archer! Also, we hope that you actively participate in many programs for the revival of the Archer Guild.
Ah, items have arrived from the Production Department. Here, take these! These are all yours!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
恭喜！你現在是一名弓箭手了！此外，我們希望你能積極參與弓箭手公會的復興活動。
啊，生產部門的物品到了。拿著，這些！這些都是你的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Having a bow and arrows, now you became a real Archer.
If you open the arrow container, there are arrows in it and then you can equip them.
Well, I expect to hear better news from you. It's time to say goodbye.
Bye.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
擁有了弓和箭，你現在才算是真正的弓箭手。
如果你開啟箭袋，裡面就有箭，然後你就可以裝備它們了。
嗯，期待聽到你的好訊息。該說再見了。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
An Archer has skills using a bow and has various talents.
The greatest ability of an Archer is attacking enemies from a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
弓箭手擁有使用弓的技能，並且具備各種才能。
弓箭手最大的能力是從遠距離攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although an Archer has weaker HP, he or she can shoot enemies at a long range,
so an Archer is safer in a real battle.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
雖然弓箭手的HP較低，但他們可以在遠距離射擊敵人，
所以在實際戰鬥中，弓箭手更安全。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although an Archer in Ragnarok has lower HP, he or she has high accuracy and attack rate so that the archer can kill monsters before they get close to an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
雖然仙境傳說中的弓箭手HP較低，但他們擁有高命中率和攻擊速度，因此弓箭手可以在魔物靠近之前將其擊殺。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
^8C2121An Archer can change jobs to a Hunter.^000000
^8C2121Other than Hunter, if you are a man, you can change your job to Bard and if you are a woman, you can change your job to Dancer.^000000
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
^8C2121弓箭手可以轉職為獵人。^000000
^8C2121除了獵人之外，如果你是男性，可以轉職為詩人；如果你是女性，可以轉職為舞娘。^000000

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you have any questions, feel free to come and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
如果你有任何問題，隨時可以來問我。
